data.title: Unit 8: Force, tools, and machines
Types of force
data.heading: Friction
data.rubric: Click on each image to learn more about friction.
data.text: Friction is the force that slows down or stops objects that are sliding past each other.
Brake pads on a bicycle rub against the rim of the tyre to slow down or stop the bicycle. This is friction.
A football rolls along the grass and eventually stops because of friction.
Air resistance is a type of friction. Instead of one object rubbing against another to slow it down, air slows the object down.
Smooth or greasy surfaces create less friction.
Rough or bumpy surfaces create more friction.
Instead of having one object rubbing against another to slow it down, air slows down the object.
Parachutes work because of air resistance.
A parachutist falls slowly because the air pushes against the parachute.
That air resistance slows down the falling parachute.
